headline_seed: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to set aside 20,000 California ballots for now - The Washington Post
draft_text:
#BreakingMews: Reuters reports the Trump DOJ filed an emergency Supreme Court appeal Monday seeking to set aside ~20,000 California mail-in ballots from suspected noncitizens — one day before the November 3, 2026 midterms.

reported by Reuters, not yet confirmed elsewhere.
